Step A — Push & Deploy to GitHub Pages First (zeerakt/rung)

          
    
            
  1. Download and unzip zeerakt_rung_repo.zip, then push to https://github.com/zeerakt/rung.git.
    2. 
            
  2. In GitHub, go to Settings → Pages → Build and deployment and set Source to GitHub Actions.
    3. 
            
  3. GitHub Actions runs all 16 unit/multiplayer specs and 300-hand simulations, then publishes your web app to https://zeerakt.github.io/rung/.
    4. 
          

          
unzip zeerakt_rung_repo.zip -d rung && cd rung
npm test
git init && git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/zeerakt/rung.git
git add . && git commit -m "feat: Rung 2.5D + Oracle VM multiplayer"
git push -u origin main

        


        

          
Step B — Provision Your Oracle Cloud (OCI) VM in 1 Command

          
    
            
  1. In Oracle Cloud Console → Networking → VCN → Security Lists, add Ingress Rules for TCP ports 80, 443, 8080.
    2. 
            
  2. SSH into your Oracle Ubuntu VM and run deploy/oracle-vm/setup_oracle_vm.sh (opens OS iptables, installs Node 20 + Nginx + systemd service).
    3. 
            
  3. Run sudo certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com so GitHub Pages (https://) can connect over wss://.
    4. 
          

          
ssh ubuntu@<YOUR_ORACLE_VM_PUBLIC_IP>
git clone https://github.com/zeerakt/rung.git
cd rung
sudo bash deploy/oracle-vm/setup_oracle_vm.sh https://github.com/zeerakt/rung.git
# Optional HTTPS/WSS TLS via Let's Encrypt:
sudo certbot --nginx -d rung.yourdomain.com

        

      

    

  


  
  

    

      

        

          Documentation, Tests & CI/CD Pipeline
          
Repository Architecture & Docs for github.com/zeerakt/rung

          
Includes complete documentation (`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/RULES.md`, `docs/PIPELINE.md`), 12 unit specs, 300-hand Monte Carlo simulation, and `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

        

        
      


      

        

          
1. Repository Directory Layout (`zeerakt_rung_repo.zip`)

          
zeerakt-rung/
├── .github/workflows/deploy.yml        # 5-Stage CI/CD -> GitHub Pages
├── deploy/oracle-vm/
│   ├── setup_oracle_vm.sh              # 1-command Oracle Cloud VM installer
│   ├── nginx-rung.conf                 # Nginx WebSocket reverse proxy config
│   └── rung-multiplayer.service        # systemd daemon service unit
├── docs/
│   ├── ARCHITECTURE.md                 # State machine & Bot AI void/boss memory
│   ├── MULTIPLAYER_ORACLE_VM.md        # GitHub Pages + Oracle VM multiplayer guide
│   ├── PIPELINE.md                     # Automated test & CI/CD pipeline guide
│   └── RULES.md                        # Single Sar, Double Sar, Chup Rung & Kot
├── server/
│   ├── roomManager.mjs                 # Authoritative rooms & Fog-of-War redaction
│   └── multiplayerServer.mjs           # Zero-dependency Node 20 WebSocket server
├── src/
│   ├── engine/rungEngine.js            # Pure state machine (Single/Double/Hidden)
│   └── ai/rungBot.js                   # Imperfect-info card tracker & tactical AI
├── tests/
│   ├── engine.test.mjs                 # 12 core engine, rule & Bot AI unit specs
│   ├── multiplayer.test.mjs            # 4 multiplayer room & Fog-of-War specs
│   └── simulation.test.mjs             # 300-hand Bot-vs-Bot invariant verifier
├── Dockerfile & docker-compose.yml     # Containerized Oracle VM deployment
├── index.html                          # Self-contained 2.5D Tabletop Web App
└── package.json                        # test, test:unit, test:mp, test:sim, start:server

        


        

          
2. Quick-Start Git Push to `zeerakt/rung`

          
unzip zeerakt_rung_repo.zip -d rung
cd rung
npm test
git init
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/zeerakt/rung.git
git add .
git commit -m "feat: add docs, 12-spec test suite, 300-hand sim & Pages CI pipeline"
git push -u origin main

          
✓ Copied Git commands to clipboard!

          

            
• In your GitHub repo settings, go to Settings → Pages → Build and deployment and set Source to GitHub Actions.

            
• Every push to main runs npm run test:docs, engine.test.mjs (12 specs), and simulation.test.mjs (300 hands) before deploying to https://zeerakt.github.io/rung/.
